title: French 1999 COMETA report conclusions

plain: The COMETA report was written in France in 1999 by a group of French experts, and according to a summary on the show it concluded that UFOs could be alien spacecraft, that there might be a base somewhere in our solar system, and that the United States was probably hiding information. The physicist Kevin Knuth gives this summary from memory, without quoting the report itself. If true, it would mean a serious French study had reached conclusions that the US has never admitted to.
